beaches.name: Vlychada
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is usual beyond the sunbeds, along the middle of the beach. A naturist directory carries visitor reports from 2001 to July 2024; a 'Nudists' sign painted on the cliffs was reported in 2008. The port end and the far west bar end stay in swimwear.

beaches.name: Koloumbo
beaches.summary: Nude and clothed bathers mix across the beach; mornings are mostly nude. A naturist directory carries reports from 1998 to July 2024; a May 2007 report describes a 'Nudism Koulombos' road sign, and an older report a tourist-office island map listing the beach as nudist.
